cells.note: Fact 2026-11-10: Phase 3 and Sonatel run a land route from Dakar to Lagos beside the cables landing in Dakar, so two routes share no landing station (SEN-010), and 2Africa at 180 Tbit/s lands at Sonatel's station (SEN-009). Onix's neutral facility at that station gives other operators wholesale access to the cables (SEN-008), so stage 5, as Angola and Namibia.
